title: Hearty Canadian Beef Wrap
description: A comforting Canadian dish featuring beef, peach juice, and a unique twist on the traditional ssam-wrap, all served in a fondue pot. This low-calorie-friendly meal is perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Heat the fondue broth in the fondue pot to 180 degrees Fahrenheit.
Add the sliced mushrooms and onions to the fondue pot and cook until they are tender.
Add the beef strips to the fondue pot and cook until they are browned.
Add the garlic, peach juice, and low-fat cheese to the fondue pot and stir until the cheese is melted.
Prepare the ssam-wrap leaves by rinsing them in cold water and patting them dry.
Assemble the wraps by placing a portion of the beef mixture onto a ssam-wrap leaf and serving immediately.
Serve the wraps with additional fondue broth for dipping.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, such as parsley or chives.
